description: This file declares the TaxRateService interface, defining methods for managing and retrieving tax rate data related to stores, countries, zones, tax classes, and languages in an e-commerce system.
external_methods: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass(Country country, Zone zone, TaxClass taxClass, MerchantStore store, Language language)

classes.name: TaxRateService
classes.description: Interface defining services for managing tax rates, including retrieval by various criteria such as store, country, zone, tax class, and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates associated with the given merchant store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates filtered by country, zone, and tax class for a specific store and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates for a country, specific state or province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a tax rate based on its unique code within a specific store.
